claims.statement: For every n>=3, the punctured codimension-two family is genuine Boolean, tensor-prime, and has Fourier degree n, with the exact H,I,U,G,Q_ge3 formulas in PUNCTURED_CODIM2_FAMILY.tex.
claims.scope: The explicit family only; no universal GU or FEI conclusion.

claims.statement: Along this family H/I->2, U/I->1, G/I->2, Q_ge3/I->1/4, and G-4I-(3/4)U->-11/4.
claims.scope: All integer n tending to infinity.

claims.statement: No universal reserve-only inequality Q_ge3>=c I can hold with c>1/4, even after restricting to tensor-prime Boolean functions of unbounded Fourier degree.
claims.scope: This does not refute c=1/4 and does not prove the signed B20 leaf.

claims.statement: G(f)<=4I(f)+(3/4)U(f) for every genuine Boolean f.
claims.scope: The family is safely negative for this residual; that is not a universal proof.
